en.headline: Dunhuang mural panels open at Yuen Long Theatre from today
en.dek: A free LCSD touring display of Sui and Tang scenes copied from cave murals runs at the theatre until 29 September before moving to Central Library.
body: A touring display of Dunhuang cave mural panels opens at Yuen Long Theatre today and stays until 29 September, the Leisure and Cultural Services Department said.

Titled The Golden Age of the Sui and Tang Dynasties Depicted in Dunhuang Murals, the exhibition is presented by LCSD with the Office for Promoting Chinese Culture and the Dunhuang Academy. Admission is free.

The boards reproduce selected mural scenes of daily life, officials and goods along the old Silk Road, which the organisers describe as a snapshot of a more open Sui and Tang society. The same touring set is also at Shek Tong Tsui Public Library through 30 September.

After Yuen Long, the display is scheduled for the exhibition space on the first floor of Hong Kong Central Library from 23 September to 31 October, then Tuen Mun Town Hall and Tsuen Wan Town Hall in October.

zh.headline: 敦煌石窟壁畫巡展今起在元朗劇院展出至月底
zh.dek: 康文署與弘揚中華文化辦公室、敦煌研究院合辦的免費巡迴展覽，以圖板重現隋唐生活場景，其後轉往中央圖書館。
body: 康樂及文化事務署表示，「敦煌石窟壁畫中的隋唐盛世」巡迴展覽今日起至9月29日在元朗劇院展出。
展覽由康文署主辦，弘揚中華文化辦公室及敦煌研究院合辦，免費入場，以圖板精選敦煌石窟壁畫，呈現古代生活、官員百姓及絲路商旅場面。
主辦單位指，展品反映敦煌作為絲路節點的多元面貌。同期石塘嘴公共圖書館亦展出至9月30日。
元朗站結束後，展覽預定9月23日至10月31日移師香港中央圖書館一樓展覽活動空間，其後10月轉往屯門大會堂及荃灣大會堂。
